# Patton Logistics Group to invest $11M to expand in Pulaski County

 Chris Graham 

 Published date: August 15, 2021 | 7:18 am Updated: May 15, 2025 | 7:10 pm 

(© vepar5 – stock.adobe.com)

The Patton Logistics Group will invest $11 million to expand its trucking, logistics, and warehousing operation in the New River Valley Commerce Park in Pulaski County.

The company will expand its newly-constructed 250,000-square-foot logistics center by an additional 150,000 square feet. This expansion will include a trucking operations and maintenance center that will provide the infrastructure to support a future investment in electric trucks.

Virginia successfully competed with Pennsylvania for the expansion project, which will create 63 new jobs.

“The Patton Logistics Group has become a significant employer in Pulaski County and the New River Valley since they came to Virginia two years ago,” Gov. # Indiana Packers marks opening of Delphi distribution center

 Tuesday, August 18, 2026 05:42 PM EDT By Alex Brown 

(Photo courtesy of Indiana Packers Corp.)

Delphi-based Indiana Packers Corp. has cut the ribbon on its new distribution center that it says more than doubles its warehouse capacity.

The new facility will bring 30 new jobs to the company’s Carroll County operation, which already employs more than 2,000 people.

“This new facility reinforces our long-term commitment to our team members, producers, customers, Carroll County, Delphi, and the northcentral Indiana community,” Indiana Packers President and Chief Operating Officer Eric Sheiss said in written remarks.

The facility, which some reports say is the result of a $44 million investment, adds more than 96,000 square feet of new freezer space for the company and increases its frozen pallet storage capacity by more than 12 times.

The company said the facility will allow it to provide faster and more efficient shipping to customers across the United States and in more than 20 other countries.

Maersk has announced a $100 million investment in a new fulfilment hub in Hopedale, Massachusetts, further expanding its contract logistics network in North America. The investment will also create approximately 1,000 new jobs across leadership, operations and support functions, delivering a significant economic boost to the local community. Recruitment is already underway ahead of the facility's opening.

# RGL Logistics unveils new warehouse in Appleton

Added capacity needed to support region’s manufacturers, company says

RGL prioritizes career development, Michelle Wellens said, while also offering paid opportunities for community volunteer work. Submitted Photo

 

Judith Munson

Contributor

October 5, 2026

APPLETON – RGL Logistics is making moves again.

The Green Bay-based company recently completed construction on a new warehouse at its Appleton campus, marking its 29th building to join its three-campus network. 

Michelle Wellens, director of transportation solutions and marketing, said the new building adds 427,500 square feet to the company’s total footprint of more than 4 million square feet, which covers all three RGL sites in Neenah, Green Bay and Appleton.

Wellens said the warehouse was built to create additional capacity and flexibility on RGL’s Appleton campus, while continuing to respond to customers’ needs.
